clauses.clause: Whenever you cast a spell that's white, blue, black, or red, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
clauses.evidence: Stimulus 'you cast an instant or sorcery (Crash Through)' (red): 'card gets 1 PLUS_1_PLUS_1 counter(s)', P/T 1/1 -> 2/2. Stimulus 'you cast a creature (Staunch Shieldmate)' (white): one counter, 1/1 -> 2/2. Tree: CastSpellEvent FOr(COLOR_HAS B/R/U/W) (COLOR_HAS, not a COLOR_IN subset test), actor YOU, PUT_COUNTER count QConst(1). Unseen cases: pack quirion_dryad_green_and_opponent_spells_no_counter (your green Titanic Growth: no counter; the opponent's red Shock: no counter; your blue Opt: one counter) PASS.
